title: lithocarpus dealbatus
intro: Lithocarpus dealbatus, commonly known as the Chinese whitebark, is a species of tree in the beech family. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional Chinese medicine, valued for its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus dealbatus include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, making it useful for treating pain, inflammation, and immune system disorders. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus dealbatus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
